identity.fullname: AI Concepts for Developers and Technology Professionals
identity.summary: Microsoft Learn's 'AI concepts for developers and technology professionals' path: seven short modules covering core AI concepts and terminology across generative AI and agents, natural language processing, speech, computer vision, information extraction, and retrieval-augmented generation. All modules are free on Microsoft Learn and need no account.

brief.topic: AI Concepts for Developers and Technology Professionals
brief.audience: Developers and technology professionals starting with AI
brief.intended_learning_outcome: Explain core AI concepts and terminology across generative AI and agents, natural language processing, speech, computer vision, information extraction, and retrieval-augmented generation, and use them to reason about AI workloads and plan AI solutions

structure.section_name: AI Concepts for Developers and Technology Professionals
structure.section_introduction: Microsoft Learn's 'AI concepts for developers and technology professionals' path: seven short modules covering core AI concepts and terminology across generative AI and agents, natural language processing, speech, computer vision, information extraction, and retrieval-augmented generation. All modules are free on Microsoft Learn and need no account. One must complete all contents to finish the course. On completion, candidates are requested to upload your badge, certification, or screenshot of completion in the assignment section.
